data.name: Mounted Blade
data.description: You can use the momentum of your mount to carry your weapon through one foe and into another.

raw_tokens.value: You can use the momentum of your mount to carry your weapon through one foe and into another.

When you use the Ride-By Attack feat, if your attack hits, you can also make an attack against a target adjacent to your original target. You take a -5 penalty on this additional attack, which does not benefit from any effects of a charge.
